name: Washed Ashore
objectiveText: Recover the Sea Turtle Remains from the Skeletal Sea Turtle in the waters west of Auberdine, and then speak with Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde back in Auberdine. Sea Turtle Remains  ( 1 )

comments.body: Location is 32,46.  Near an underwater shipwreck.

It's a common mistake to look for the remains at the beached turtle just south of Auberdine, even though the quest tells you west. That's the incorrect turtle. The actual turtle that will give you the remains is located just west of the Auberdine docks, under the water. You can see it if you swim out to the island that you fly over when you take a Hyppogryph ride. If you're on the island, look toward the docks.
replies: Run to the end of the pier.  When you reach the intersection, turn left (to the boat to Menethil).  When you get to the end, you'll see the turtle under the water.  Dive in, swim out.

Some clarification of the location might be useful for those who are having some trouble finding it (it took me over an hour).  Start on the Long Wash dock, standing on the left hand (south) fork.  Looking south, you should be able to see a small island, and if you look down in the water you may be able to see a shipwreck.  The turtle is between the dock and the island, south of the shipwreck.  You can see the turtle on the minimap, even, as a light gray dot between the landmarks I described.  The dot is kind of subtle, but once you see it, you'll know exactly where to head.  If you can't find it on the minimap, just swim around looking for the turtle's big shell.

Once you reach the turtle, you will notice that you can't loot it from the surface.  You'll have to dive to get it.  Try adjusting your camera angle so you can actually see what you're doing, but otherwise just look for the gold cursor to loot the remains.  If you do it blind, be aware that you CAN get yourself stuck inside the turtle shell and not see what's going on.  I would recommend using the hearthstone to get yourself out of there (you will have plenty of time if you use it when the blue breath bar passes to the left of the word "Breath"; you might want to make sure your stone is set to Auberdine first).  I, personally, was a little too slow the first time, and the only way I figured out I was stuck inside the shell was that I could see it with my wisp.  If you simply resurrect yourself and use the hearthstone right away, you won't have a problem.

Hello there fellow gamers, hope you getting some fun from your experiences.

In order to loot the remains, you must swim under water untill your cursor changes to a golden wheel, right clicking at that time will automatically loot the turtle's remains.

In order to swim under water, you must hold both the left and right mouse keys and adjust your camera angle into a downward sighting.  This will or should cause your character to dive down to the remains.

I hope this helps and please remember to have fun, don't get to frustrated and always ask for help when you can't figure things out for yourself.

WoW is a game that was created to force each and every player to work and play in groups.  There are quests you can solo, but in most higher level parts of the game you will need help.  So you might as well learn how to play your character(s) in a group setting, as either a lead, Warriors and Paladins, or in supporting role.
